card.name: Partway through drug-label heading terms
card.fires_on: Fires on a word or piece in the middle of a drug-related phrase in labels, such as UG in DRUG INTERACTIONS, ation in Medication Guide, or the decimal point in 1.6 to 1.7 times. It also fires on a space before a dose number.

modes.label: Inside heading words
modes.description: Partway through words like DRUG or Medication in label headings and guide names.

modes.label: Inside numbers and doses
modes.description: The decimal point in a risk range or the space before a dose amount.
modes.example: between 1.6 to 1<<.>>7 times the risk of death in placebo

modes.label: Word before drug term
modes.description: A word just before a drug-related noun such as elimination or Gelatin Capsules.
modes.example: initiating the accelerated<< drug>> elimination procedure

card.writes: It lowers product-related words in English and Chinese and raises algorithm-related words, so the effect is mixed.
card.plain: It responds to the middle of a drug-label phrase or number, where the next piece is still expected.
